notes.title: Update 1.2.09213
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few more annoying issues, some of which were introduced in recent updates (sorry!)


 Fixed an issue with mouse wheel zooming the wrong way when changing scroll direction.
 The region reveal animation no longer zooms out.
 Fixed clue numbers not disappearing during the region reveal animation.
 The reveal animation has been polished up a bit, with nicer SFX.
 Fixed an issue with UI region/count info only updating once a second.
 Clearing errors no longer makes the horrible overlapping sound of dozens of tiles flipping.
 The undo button is now hidden once you've completed the puzzle.
 Slowed down the endgame replay slightly.

notes.title: Update 1.2.09103
notes.notes:
This update addresses a few more QoL issues and bugs:

Ctrl+Z no longer also triggers the Z zoom hotkey.

Added a mousewheel sensitivity slider to the settings menu.

Added multiple backups for replay saves.

Reworked the undo system, so that it behaves more naturally.

Tweaked the text in the how to play popup to clarify some common misunderstandings.

notes.title: Update 1.1.09094
notes.notes:
This update introduces partial gamepad support for Proverbs, allowing you to sit back and enjoy the game with a controller, as well as making greater use of the Steam Deck's controls. Make sure to use the new official gamepad layout.



In addition, this update includes a range of improvements and bugfixes:

Added VSync options to the settings menu.

You can now hold shift+click as an alternative to right-clicking.

Redesigned loading screen.

100% completion achievement and "Watch Replay" feature now correctly require you to have the entire board solved, not just filled.

Added a text description to the highlight opacity setting.

Balanced volume levels between music tracks.

The "skip track" keyboard shortcut (spacebar) now works again.



Finally, new translations have been added for the following languages:

Portuguese

Polish

Turkish

Korean



If you haven't done so already, be sure to wishlist Mosaic of the Strange. You'll be able to play the demo in the upcoming Steam Next Fest in October!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3444650/Mosaic_of_the_Strange/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Update 1.1.09024
notes.notes:
This update addresses several bugs and QoL issues:


 The final achievement should no longer require a restart to trigger
 An issue with how replays were recorded has been fixed, which means that new players should be able to watch their replay correctly. (This can't fix the replay for players that are already part or all of the way through, unfortunately).
 Mousewheel scroll sensitivity has been drastically reduced on mac (this will be configurable in a future update)
 The "Fullscreen: on/off" text on the settings menu is no longer inverted
 The "how to play" screen is now much more readable on Steam Deck
 The game now zooms out to reveal the region you just completed
 The main menu cross-promo widget now cycles through all Divide the Plunder games that you don't own, highlighting any that are out soon or on special offer.

notes.title: Update 1.1.02081
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug in which double-clicking on a tile could cause a mismatch between a tile’s visual state and its "true" state.
 Using Ctrl+Z to undo no longer triggers the zoom-in keyboard shortcut at the same time.
 Fixed the undo feature panning the camera to random locations instead of undoing your moves.

notes.title: Update 1.1.01101
notes.notes:
The error sound no longer plays when error reporting is turned off.
 Fixed the % symbol on the main menu appearing as a square in some languages
 Fixed the discord link in the settings menu

notes.title: Update 1.1.12182: Discord, Newsletter, and a Free Sequel!
notes.notes:
Updates:

 Settings menu: added a link to the new discord
 Settings menu: added a link to the newsletter sign-up


New Game Announcement!

[previewyoutube=vGXn43o0IdM;full][/previewyoutube]

To celebrate the end of the year, I’m thrilled to announce the release of 2024: Mosaic Retrospective, the third entry in the Mega Mosaic series!

This is a full 60,000 tile Mega Mosaic game and is completely free for anyone to download and play!

As you solve the puzzle you'll reveal a stunning pixel art collage crammed with over 90 news stories from 2024, ranging from politics, war, science, pop culture, music and memes... just about anything and everything that made the headlines!

While the game is free, I have created an accompanying fundraiser for UNICEF. If you enjoy the experience, please consider donating to it and help me reach my £2,000 goal to support children worldwide. Every contribution counts!

Donate | Download Now!

Newsletter registration open!
Recent changes to the Steam News feed mean that it might be harder for me to notify you that a game that you enjoyed has a sequel. To make sure you get all the latest news, you can sign up for the email newsletter.

Discord launched!
Want to discuss your mosaic-solving techniques with other players? Want to ping me a quick question directly? There is now an official Divide the Plunder Discord available! Join the conversation.

Thank you for your support, and I hope you love solving the new entry!

Cheers,
Mark

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3380760/2024_Mosaic_Retrospective/

notes.title: Update 1.1.12120
notes.notes:
This update introduces several QoL improvements:


 Regions now have clearer, thicker, black borders.
 Zoom can now also be controlled using the keyboard shortcuts Z and X.
 Fixed the missing % symbol on the main menu in certain languages.

notes.title: Update 1.1.11180
notes.notes:
This update contains a few more small fixes:


 Edge scroll now works in full screen mode
 Clicking to close the proverbs panel no longer accidentally flips a tile
 You can now skip the current track by pressing spacebar

notes.title: Update 1.1.11171
notes.notes:
This update addresses a few bits of feedback:


 Added edge scrolling as an optional setting.
 Added a brightness slider for the highlight around the cursor.
 Added recovery mode which can help recover some progress in the event of a lost save.
 Fixed a bug that would allow the undo button to clear tiles from a solved region (any regions affected by this will now be fixed on startup).
 Fixed an issue with clue numbers temporarily disappearing after solving a region.
 The top-right global counter is now also using the clearer font.

notes.title: Update 1.1.11150
notes.notes:
The update fixes a handful of annoying issues:


 Progress counters have been reverted to the previous, more readable font.
 Using the mouse wheel while in a separate window no longer zooms the board.
 Fixed an visual glitch that would appear to flip random tiles when clicking rapidly.
 Fixed an issue with the "reset puzzle" feature.

notes.title: Update 1.1.11111
notes.notes:
This update fixes a few issues:


 Fixed audio levels resetting when using Esc to exit the menu.
 Clicking and dragging no longer fills adjacent regions.
 Fixed the highlight and hint effects being partially obscured by tiles.
 The top bar is now localised.
 Added an option to settings to invert left and right click.
 Fixed an issue with region achievements not retroactively unlocking on boot.
 Fonts are now more consistent throughout the UI.

notes.title: Update 1.0.11100
notes.notes: This update includes a fix for achievements not triggering (they should now unlock on boot if you should already have earned them).

notes.title: Update 1.0.11091
notes.notes:
This small update makes a few improvements to the launch version of the game:


 Fixed flickering tile edges (z-fighting)
 Allow game window to be freely resized
 Ctrl+Z is now bound as shortcut for undo (alongside the U and Backspace keys)
 Reduced save frequency to improve performance (every 30 seconds, and whenever you quit)
